Wonderful Neighborhood Dining Experience
Oct 2026 • Couples
From the way the staff greeted us, to the last bite of our key lime tart dessert, this was an exceptional dining experience. The staff is quite attentive, service is prompt & accurate, the food was well prepared & presented & the flavors were delicious. They had us when they served warm fresh bread before the meal. Portion sizes were large enough that my wife & I were able to share a garden salad & entree of chicken parmesan & have room for a delightfully tart key lime tart. This is a warm & intimately friendly place that even has a group room upstairs. It is fairly recently under new ownership & they are working hard to make this a first class dining experience. And it is a 5 minute walk from our hotel without having to cross one street.

Sep 2020 • Friends
We ordered 6 dishes and 3 desserts. The best one we got was the dessert Death by Chocolate. Others were from average or below, especially the main dish Oven Baked Blackened Chicken and the dessert Pancake Crepes. About the chicken, I got it from the name that the chicken should look on the darker side, but didn't expect it to be completely burned and taste like charcoal. About the dessert, the combination of crepe and pancake simply didn't work (at least for our group of 5), and the flavour was really odd.

The service seems also a bit strange. When we asked about the chicken, the waiter immediately became very defensive and basically told us that we had no knowledge of how this chicken dish should be, and the completely burned chicken was well done. I saw the photo of the same dish someone else post here, and that's certainly not black and not the same as what we got. 

There're definitely better Mediterranean restaurants in Saigon.
